response.justification: The candidate is an experienced, versatile senior engineer, but the profile does not align with the core requirements of this role. Hands-on C++ work is limited to roughly six months at National Instruments (2014–2015) plus a university thesis project, far short of the 5–10 years of professional C++ required. There is no evidence of Windows-platform systems development, no SQL Server or Oracle experience (only MySQL/MongoDB listed generically), and no fixed income, derivatives, capital markets, or investment banking domain exposure — the RIDE Capital role was a Node/TypeScript/GraphQL fintech product, not a capital-markets engineering environment. The career trajectory is firmly web/backend (TypeScript, Node.js, DLang), which would require substantial retraining for this position.
strengths: Broad senior-level engineering experience with strong software craftsmanship, TDD, and CI/CD practices
Proven low-latency, high-throughput systems work (millions of req/s at Sociomantic/Dunnhumby)
Excellent communication evidenced by workshops, conference talks, and course authoring; fluent English
concerns: Only ~6 months of professional C++ experience versus the required 5–10 years
No fixed income, derivatives, or investment banking/capital markets domain background
No demonstrated Windows-platform development or SQL Server/Oracle database expertise

key_factors.factor: Windows platform and SQL Server/Oracle experience
